children: S&P 500 September futures were quoted at 7,673.50 at 9:01 a.m., down 3.00 points, or 0.04%, from the previous close, according to ETNet.

U.S. Treasury yields also eased, with the 30-year yield at 5.260%, the 10-year at 4.780%, the 5-year at 4.539%, the 3-year at 4.441% and the 2-year at 4.373%. Spot gold in London was quoted at 4,383.86/4,384.20, while spot silver was at 65.37/65.42. 99 gold was quoted at 40,380.

title: S&P 500 Futures Edge Lower; U.S. Treasury Yields Ease
